name: claude-harness
description: Koren's personal Claude Code harness: mods and rules

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: Adds a TLDR button that summarizes Claude's latest response in a side pane

plugins.name: diagram
plugins.description: Adds a Diagram button that draws the flow or architecture from Claude's latest response in its own pane tab

plugins.name: agent-dock
plugins.description: Agents side panel: every agent you can run, with run, pause, stop and open-in-tab controls, plus an Agents button and a context window bar with a Compact button above the prompt

plugins.name: rephrase
plugins.description: Adds a Rephrase button that rewrites the draft in the prompt box with a small model, so the LLM gets a clearer, structured prompt. Undo restores the original

plugins.name: blind-spots
plugins.description: Adds a Blind Spots button above the prompt that asks Claude to list the engineering blind spots in the current plan or design

plugins.name: help-offers
plugins.description: Turns the 'How I can help' list at the end of an answer into buttons that start a subagent for each offer
